segments.title: Part 1: Original

tenBlocks.block3_goal: A seven-shot, thirty-second segment inside a three-part animated family comedy. It establishes an ordinary living-room world and escalates a card-battle gag between brothers and sister to a proud scientist beat. It ends the instant DadShaz voiceover finishes saying scientist made Mom light up — do not continue, do not resolve anything, do not add an ending. The comedy is played completely straight. Nobody in frame knows anything is funny.
tenBlocks.block4_continuity: Location: the room in @family_living_room, morning, throughout. Never leave it. The camera stays on the same side of the action as in @family_living_room for the whole segment and never crosses to the other side. @Shaz sits center on rug, @Brother left and @Sister right when present, @Mom beside @Shaz, and this never flips. 180-degree axis from TV toward sofa locked for all shots. No background characters appear; only the named cast are present with zero face repeats. Costume is fixed for the whole segment and never changes. @Mom wears deep teal hijab with no visible hair, hairline or dark band, @Sister wears muted plum hijab with no visible hair, hairline or dark band. Yugioh cards stay scattered on rug throughout.
tenBlocks.block6_visualStyle: Feature-quality 3D animated film, production CG, stylized cinematic warmth, not flat cartoon. Warm morning daylight through tall windows, soft subsurface glow through ears and skin, tactile fabric, wood and card materials. Depth of field as a natural in-camera optical artifact with soft background falloff. Clean family comedy staging with rich readable silhouettes.
tenBlocks.block7_cameraAndPerformance: Seven shots with six hard cuts in thirty seconds. The body plays broad. The face stays honest. No mugging, no pulled faces, no comic reactions. Anticipation winds opposite before moves. Snap and Settle with fast transitions and overshoot on arrival. Moving Holds breathe and micro-shift, never frozen. Overlap and Secondary Action with hair, cloth and cards arriving late. Eye Life with micro-saccades, catchlights and natural blinks, eyes never glaze.
tenBlocks.block8_audio: Foley of plastic cards shuffling and soft taps on rug, light footsteps and fabric rustle. Quiet living-room atmosphere with faint cartoon battle music from TV. Subtle pizzicato strings for comedic timing accents, warm swell under proud beat, then gentle fade. Room tone stays soft and continuous.
tenBlocks.block9_exclusions: The only spoken words in the entire segment are the lines in braces. Nothing else written anywhere in this prompt is dialogue, and nobody speaks who is not named on a line. No extra cuts anywhere. No unison movement. No subtitles, no watermark, no logo. No new characters, no new locations, no costume changes.
tenBlocks.block10_maintainConsistency: Maintain five characters @Shaz, @Brother, @Sister, @Mom, @DadShaz and one location @family_living_room with fixed faces and heights. Toddler equals 4 heads tall. Child equals 4.5 to 5 heads tall with long torso and short legs for @Shaz and @Brother. Adult equals 7 heads tall for @DadShaz and @Mom, with @Sister shown as 18 with adult-like proportions. Costumes, hijabs, sunglasses and beards never change. No face repeats.

shots.action: Wide shot from sofa side toward TV showing @Shaz center and @Brother left sitting on rug among scattered cards watching TV breathing and blinking
Medium shot on @Brother holding a card out toward @Shaz while both breathe and shift on rug

dialogue.speaker: @Brother
dialogue.line: {I call first! You lost last time!}

shots.action: Close shot on @Shaz looking down arranging cards quietly breathing and blinking with straight honest face
Medium shot with @Sister leaning in gesturing while @Shaz clamps cards to chest breathing

dialogue.speaker: @Sister
dialogue.line: {My turn! No one beats my dragon!}

shots.action: Medium shot of @Shaz on knees bobbing up and down while @Sister reacts breathing beside him
Close shot of @Mom leaning toward @Shaz both breathing and blinking with warm proud expression

dialogue.speaker: @Mom
dialogue.line: {My scientist! I am so proud of you!}

shots.action: Medium close shot of @Shaz holding cards up while @Mom smiles beside him breathing calmly

dialogue.speaker: @DadShaz
dialogue.line: {I was eight. I did not talk much. Saying scientist made Mom light up.}

No background characters appear; only @DadShaz is present with zero face repeats. Costume is fixed for the whole segment and never changes. Faded coupe with no air conditioning stays parked in same spot.

tenBlocks.block10_maintainConsistency: Maintain one character @DadShaz and two locations @family_driveway and @home_bedroom_office with fixed face and height. Adult equals 7 heads tall. Toddler equals 4 heads tall. Child equals 4.5 to 5 heads tall with long torso and short legs as scale reference. Costume, sunglasses and beard never change. Car position and desk setup never change. No face repeats.

shots.action: Wide shot of @DadShaz standing by car door in driveway breathing and blinking calmly

dialogue.speaker: @DadShaz
dialogue.line: {At seventeen I got my license. I did not have to ask for rides.}

shots.action: Medium shot of @DadShaz leaning into car tapping dashboard breathing with proud energy

dialogue.speaker: @DadShaz
dialogue.line: {Put my song on! This is ours!}

shots.action: Close shot of @DadShaz crouching plugging cable in breathing steadily beside car
Medium shot of @DadShaz sitting at desk typing breathing and blinking in lamplight

dialogue.speaker: @DadShaz
dialogue.line: {I finished early at McKinney Boyd. I doubled up and kept going.}

shots.action: Close shot of @DadShaz staring at laptop screen breathing and nodding slowly

dialogue.speaker: @DadShaz

shots.action: Medium shot of @DadShaz leaning back exhaling breathing calmly with quiet pride

dialogue.speaker: @DadShaz
dialogue.line: {Fifty thousand felt like six figures at home. For the first time I did it.}
